verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The closure model now evaluates workspace feature selections, optional dependency activation, default-feature behavior, dependency feature forwarding, and command-specific dev-dependency inclusion. The focused synthetic tests independently demonstrate that disabled optional dependencies are absent and appear only when activated, while the real-manifest test confirms that service-loopback adds tokio to an otherwise tokio-free closure. The workflow grouping, measurement gate, and CI wiring are also pinned by non-vacuity and structural tests. The documented external-crate feature-resolution limitation remains an explicit conservative approximation and does not invalidate the workspace-boundary correction requested in round 1.
